title: Billycart Derby
tagline: Build it. Steer it. Roll it down the hill.
description: A gravity-powered cart race seen from behind the cart: build your billycart from wheels, frame, steering, brake and ballast, then steer it past hay bales and crowds against three rivals. Five hills, a daily hill, ghosts and a cup.
howToPlay: Build your cart in the garage: each part has trade-offs.
Tap just after GO for a launch, then slide your thumb to steer.
Brake before bends: too fast and the cart slides wide.
Take the inside line, dodge ruts and bales, draft rivals.
Beat three rivals, or the ghost of your best run.
